phases.description: CORRECTED 2026-07-31. The streams below were specified against line counts that were wrong by 10-100x and named duplicate implementations that do not exist. Re-measured: MarketFeed is 800 lines (not 34,952), FeedMonitor 813 (not 36,084), FeedRecoveryCoordinator 423 (not 16,626), ParquetMarketProvider 290 (not 11,188). The feed modules are already composed (MarketFeed owns a supervisor, has set_recovery(), check_stale()); merging them would ADD ~1,350 lines and remove no logic. SQLiteOrderStore is a complementary boot-restore mirror, not a duplicate — event projection already exists at startup.py:1496. simple_sync.py is the WRITE path, not a duplicate of the read path. Streams 3 and 4 as originally specced would have deleted working, tested, already-integrated components.
